### A Prayer for Quiet Trust in God
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-quiet-trust-in-god.html
Passage: Isaiah 18:4
Points:
- God’s presence in our lives is often quiet and steady rather than flashy or dramatic.
- When prayer answers seem slow, we can trust that God is actively caring for us behind the scenes.
- Just as summer heat quietly nurtures growing crops, God works patiently toward an eventual harvest in our lives.
- Quiet seasons strengthen faith by teaching us to rest in God during ordinary days.
- Waiting with hope allows believers to trade anxiety for confidence in God's perfect timing.
